description: graspy's design tokens for the web and Android. One brand blue; green only for right or finished; subject tiles alone get a tint per family. Contrast ratios are WCAG, against white unless another ground is named. After editing, run `node content/design/build.mjs` from the repository root.

raised.description: A quiet band inside a card.

subtle.description: Small print that still reads as text: 4.6:1 on white, 4.3:1 on canvas, so on canvas use muted.

faint.description: Only for icons beside a label and other non-text: 3.05:1.

track.description: The empty part of a progress bar.

accent.description: The brand blue. 3.4:1: fills, borders, focus rings and button labels, never body text.

accent-strong.description: A pressed or hovered accent fill. 5.5:1.

accent-ink.description: Blue text and links. 5.5:1; 4.9:1 on accent-soft.

accent-soft.description: A selected row, the selected tab's pill, the tutor's ground.

accent-line.description: The border of an accent-soft area.

on-accent.description: Text and icons on an accent fill.

success.description: Right or finished, and nothing else. 5.6:1; 5.0:1 on success-soft.

success-soft.description: The ground of a right answer or a finished topic.

warning.description: Dark enough for small text: 5.4:1; 4.8:1 on warning-soft.

warning-line.description: The border of a warning-soft area.

danger.description: Errors and destructive actions. 5.4:1; 4.7:1 on danger-soft.

tint-green.description: Subject tiles only; never for text.

tint-orange.description: Subject tiles only; never for text.

tint-purple.description: Subject tiles only; never for text.

display.description: Headings. Poppins cannot stack a tone mark over a dot-below letter (Yoruba "ẹ́"), so Yoruba headings use sans.

numeral.description: The number a voice lesson asks the learner to read, from arm's length.

pill.description: Fully round: chips, the selected tab, progress bars.

unit.description: One step of the spacing scale; a gap of n steps is n times this (the web's p-4 is 16px).
